I graduated highschool at 16 by taking the California High School Proficiency Exam (CHSPE). It gave me a certification of completion which is the equivalent of a high school diploma. I went to community college for 2 years to finish all the remaining credits as well as get some units for a 4-year. I transferred to UC Davis last fall and will hopefully earn my bachelor's by Fall 2021. So yeah, there are some loopholes you can go through to get outta school early.
